scope: Synthetic neural-population control; not a biological or optogenetic efficacy claim.

hypotheses.H1: Ordered H4 history reduces tracking RMSE relative to the memoryless learned controller under low-sensitivity plant shift.
hypotheses.H2: H4 beats the prespecified PI controller at sensitivity 0.60 and 0.80, but is not expected to beat PI universally.
hypotheses.H3: Jointly shuffling aligned historical (rate, action) pairs degrades H4 closed-loop performance at sensitivity 0.60 and 0.80.
hypotheses.H4: Controller rankings are regime-dependent; at sensitivity 1.20 PI is expected to outperform H4.

mechanistic_conditions.comparison: ordered H4 vs joint-shuffled aligned pairs

confirmation.rule: These seeds become spent immediately after the first completed confirmation run.
confirmation.uncertainty: paired bootstrap 95% CI and paired win fraction; preserve model-initialization results rather than selecting the best model
